stage: before e3-e6 hardware runs; after Qwen e1 gate

changes.reason: Preflight found original complete source set includes 1GiB SSD; pure-DRAM filter falsely rejected rank4
changes.policy: A uses its original valid DRAM+SSD sources, unchanged; B retains complete DRAM requirement. Record tier bytes and actual owner-build source bytes; owner setup outside IPC hit, fresh export inside request metric. No source relocation to satisfy a mistaken preflight.

changes.reason: CPU-only preview found equal objective/density choices; lexicographic-only tie could concentrate both blocks in one rank
changes.policy: Rank by marginal gain per allocated GiB rounded to 12 decimals; equal density prefers lower resulting objective (greater absolute gain) rounded to 12 decimals, then candidate IDs. Singleton and paired-rank bundles both available. No measured timing used to tune tie-break.

unchanged: budgets, target groups, scenario weights, primary metric, correctness, executor, sample counts and source retention
decision_identity: Equal layout and route must be recorded as no decision increment; identical cases can reuse observations with aliases, never count them as independent samples
